title: The black square
prompt:
Darkness still has a least significant part.
The clock must arrive before the image can speak: take the decimal answer of Three incompatible clocks as K.
Flatten the 64 by 64 lossless negative in row-major order. For i=0..79, pixel index=(109*i+(K mod 4096)) mod 4096.
Take each selected red sample's least significant bit. Form ten bytes, MSB-first.
XOR those ten bytes with the first ten bytes of SHA-256(ASCII decimal K, no newline).
The first two clear bytes are a big-endian byte count; the next bytes are ASCII.
Transparency remembers a second text: its first 80 low bits have reversed their entire order.
Its door is hidden in the image's companion record.
